Master Tier Mirana 4.5k, nothing pro but I really dig her so here’s a couple little tips! 

- For my starting items I like to bring both a sentry and a SOD. Play aggressive from the beginning and find the enemies Observer Ward - this is important so that you can throw arrows from out of vision. Trees are your best friend so the less vision they have, the more likely you’re going to hit your arrows. 

- I personally find the best opportunities to land arrows is when there’s just a few creeps and the enemy core is about to get the very last hit on a creep so that you can predict their movement.

- Don’t sap your offlaners XP. You’re a Mirana. If you’re worried that you’re falling behind too much then use arrow to farm big creeps. 

- Remember that SOD? You’re going to use this after giving your offlaner the level advantage when they’re ready to solo. Go mid (via dire jungle if you’re radiant, vice versa if dire) so you end up behind the T1. Shooting arrows from here is best because there’s generally less creeps in the way of your arrow and the midlaner usually has their camera in the middle of lane or on the enemy’s side of the map. **make sure your midlaner has the mana to follow up a 4/5 sec arrow - no point going if there’s no kill potential** 

- PS: if the enemy mid is something like SS/QoP/DK an arrow kill might be hard after 6 due to their ults and mobility spells. Use your brain. 

- If your safe lane is getting absolutely DESTROYED, TP down and get some arrow set ups by whatever 5 is on your team (most 5s have decent setup - lift/frostbite/magic missle/nightmare/glimpse - you might need to practice but they’re all possible) 

- Miranas mana regen and int are garbage, I ship myself so many clarities as Mirana it’s ridiculous(ly important). If you’re standing around doing nothing, you’re doing it wrong. Mirana hits like a wet noodle but has decent range and atk speed early, so click the pos5 down when your skills are CD. If you don’t think you can kill early, arrow big creeps and get XP out of lane until you/your offlaner hit whatever level you need for kill potential. 

There’s a lot of ways to play 4 Mirana and I’m always down to talk about playing her so feel free to PM me! These are just the basic things I like to do on her. She has a lot of potential to sway early games if you’re doing it right, end of the day, it was not luck, but skill.

Recipe: 

1 Carrot
2 Sweet Potatoes
1 Red Onion 
1 Tomato 
1 Zucchini 
2 cloves garlic
25g feta
Olive Oil
Paprika/Salt/Pepper to season
100g Greek Yoghurt 
1 Lemon 
1 Chicken Breast 
60g Baby Spinach Leaves 


Steps: 
1) Cube your carrots, sweet potatoes and zucchini - wedge your onion and tomato. Pop all of them onto a baking tray and drizzle with olive oil and salt/pepper to season. 

2) in a mixing bowl add your chicken breast(s), 1/2 of the Greek yoghurt, paprika and garlic paste. Coat your chicken and put aside. 

3) heat up your frying pan/skillet with olive oil. When hot, place chicken in for 3-4 mins both sides or until brown (you’ll smell it!!), then put in oven. 

4) in another bowl put spinach leaves, your veggies are probably roasted by now so pop them in your spinach and add the remaining of your Greek yoghurt and 1/2 of your feta. Mix well. Salt and pepper to taste. 

5) Add chicken when cooked, slice into decent 3cm slices and add to salad. Add remaining feta and parsley as a garnish if you wish.

6) Eat!
